The '''Desert Demons''' were a criminal gang which operated on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They were rivals of several [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]].

==History==
{{Quote|Desert Demons. I couldn't do anything to stop them.|[[Draci]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Darklighter Cache|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
[[File:DesertDemonDoll.png|thumb|left|100px|A Tusken doll of a Desert Demon]]
During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a gang of criminals known as the [[Desert/Legends|Desert]] [[Demon/Legends|Demons]] were based out of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Desert Demons tended to roam throughout Tatooine in groups, or operate out of small temporary encampments and settlements.<ref name="AED" /> The gang rivaled several opposing [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gangs]],<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref> and Tatooine's native [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] were known to have produced at least one [[Desert Demon Doll|doll]] of a Desert Demon.<ref name="SWG:TV">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Tusken Valuables}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of Desert Demons assassinated [[Janus]], the warehouse manager of [[Tosche Station/Legends|Tosche Station]], after his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] broke down in the desert.<ref name="SWG:TS" /> Around the same time, Desert Demons invaded the [[Darklighter cache|Darklighter cave]], a cache used by the [[Darklighter family/Legends|Darklighter family]] to stock supplies and equipment. Many of them were killed when spacers looking for a cargo smuggled from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] assaulted the cave.<ref name="SWG:DC" />

==Members==
[[File:Desert_Demons_2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A group of Desert Demons.]]
Members of the Desert Demons included a number of different [[Species/Legends|species]] of mutliple [[Gender/Legends|genders]], including [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. Their memberbase comprised of [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], [[Unarmed combat/Legends|brawlers]], and [[Sniper/Legends|marksmen]], all of whom were led by a series of Desert Demon gang leaders.<ref name="AED" /> Depending on their position, members of the gang were skilled at various forms of combat, including [[Teräs Käsi/Legends|Teräs Käsi]].<ref name="Total">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Total Experience'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Members also possessed an arsenal of various weapons, including [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] weapons<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> and ranged weapons.<ref name="JTL">[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Some examples included the [[laser carbine]] and [[DH-17 blaster carbine/Legends|DH-17 carbine]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[W:c:swg:Desert Demons|Desert Demons]] were included as a [[W:c:swg:Faction|faction]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> They were found exclusively on [[W:c:swg:Tatooine|Tatooine]], and were designated as opponents of the [[W:c:swg:Swoop Gang|Swoop Gang]] faction.<ref name="AED" /> Players who completed the "[[W:c:swg:Tusken Valuables|Tusken Valuables]]" [[W:c:swg:Collection|collection]] would receive a [[W:c:swg:A Demon Doll|Desert Demon Doll]] as a [[W:c:swg:Collection reward|reward]].<ref name="SWG:TV" /> The Desert Demons are also listed in all five of the [[W:c:swg:Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies'']] [[Prima Games|Prima]] strategy guides.<ref name="Prima" /><ref name="Quick">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided Quick Reference Guide]]''</ref><ref name="JTL" /><ref name="Total" /><ref name="Complete">[[Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Galaxies: The Complete Guide'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>
